description: This Java source file defines the Office entity within the Fineract project. It models organizational offices, including hierarchy management, creation, and updates, with annotations for ORM mapping and Lombok-generated methods.

classes.name: Office
classes.description: Represents an organizational Office with hierarchy management, creation, and update capabilities, mapped via JPA for persistence.

methods.name: headOffice
methods.description: Creates a new Office instance representing a head office with specified name, opening date, and external ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Instantiates an Office object from JSON command input, establishing parent-child relationships.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Office's properties based on JSON Command input, tracking changes.

methods.name: isOpeningDateBefore
methods.description: Checks if the Office's opening date is before a given date.

methods.name: isOpeningDateAfter
methods.description: Checks if the Office's opening date is after a given date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Office's hierarchical parent, with validation.

methods.name: identifiedBy
methods.description: Checks whether the Office's ID matches a given ID.

methods.name: generateHierarchy
methods.description: Generates or updates the hierarchy string based on parent Office.

methods.name: hierarchyOf
methods.description: Constructs the hierarchy string for a given Office ID.

methods.name: hasParentOf
methods.description: Checks if the Office has the given Office as its parent.

methods.name: doesNotHaveAnOfficeInHierarchyWithId
methods.description: Determines if the Office's hierarchy does not contain an Office with given ID.

methods.name: hasAnOfficeInHierarchyWithId
methods.description: Recursively checks if Office hierarchy contains Office with specific ID.

methods.name: loadLazyCollections
methods.description: Triggers fetching of lazy-loaded child offices.
